name: Vương
source: Your once-betrothed crown prince, the one you are accused of killing in a tragic fire. Engaged to you since childhood, Vuong embodied every trait of a perfect ruler. Yet, fate severed your bond through death. So why do his shadow and the bittersweet echoes of his memories still torment your nights?
